items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Ori and I at 4th and Stanford in Los Angeles... Ori had him a little brass band. Black Benny was playing bass drum with him.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Um, what about, uh, the raids out in California that you told me about? Thanks. Mm-hmm.

We were playing at, uh, at the Dreamland Cafe, nightclub, you know. Mm-hmm. We were playing for the Spike Brothers. You heard of them. Mm-hmm. We were playing for the Spike Brothers. Ori and I at 4th and Stanford in Los Angeles. I'll never forget that. And, uh, we were playing there one night, one Sunday night, I'll never forget it. And the police had told, Reb Spikes was the tenor player, you see. Yeah, Reb Spikes, Reb and Johnny. Johnny was the oldest brother. Reb was a tall, nice-looking boy. And he had told…
